user_reviews.title: Mind-blowing purchase
user_reviews.review_text: This is a superb product made by Bosch Pros:- 1. Design is Super Modern 2. Gets its job of washing utensils very well and very clean 3. The utensils are Super Dry when they comes out No need to mess with watery utensils 4. it uses warm water at the time of washing at 60 degrees so every bacteria will be dead 5. it uses 3 types of things : 1 .one is dishwashing detergents which is to be put every time you wash one scoop 2. one is rinse aid which helps you to dry out the utensils at the end this you have to fill in every 1-2 weeks 3. and last one is dishwashing salt which is to be filled in every 1-1.5 month. All the things will be made available by the bosch personal or the installation guy which comes at your home and it will be of bosch itself that will be perfect for your machine and it will be way less priced than Finnish product the, it will cost about 770 rs per 1.5 month these 3 things of bosch company and the same product of Finnish will cost abut 990 rs for about only for 1 month and the price which the bosch guy gives is same as online 6. the grease that was stuck in the utensils for years will also remove Cons:- 1. You first of all have to get a Fixed Connection for water and electricity. the installation guy will not do this. 2. If you want an original stand for this machine that will cost about 5000rs and most of you have to buy a different one from other manufacturers Advice;- 1. you should have to get a proper water connection at the rate of 10 liters per minute 2. and proper fixed wiring with proper earthing 3. you cannot keep ceramic and wooden items in it because the are reactive to high temperatures and aluminum items will be get fade away its shine becz of its reactive to the dishwashing rinse aid

user_reviews.title: Pretty good
user_reviews.review_text: After use of one week of dishwasher here is my review.. 1. It is very good dishwasher with excellent ability to clean basic utensils perfectly despite some issues of cleaning sticky parts of kadhai and milk pots. ( But of u keep soaked inside water, even these utensils get cleaned perfectly) 2. Water used for this dishwasher is very less which is around 10 litr per wash. Only requirement is that drinking purpose water or municipal water shall be used strictly and not bore water or salty water. 3. Tablets or detergents specially made for dishwasher mist be used only. For best effect finish tablets are good but they are costly (30 rs per tablet)so for cheaper and better result go for IFB detergent, salt rinse aid combo or go for fortune tablets which are good enough. ( 15 rs per tablet). 4. Energy used is around 2 units per wash so 60 monthly consumption of units shall be added to your elctricity consumption. 5. This is perfect appliance for situations particularly like.lockdown.. though some cons such as higher cost on detergent and electricity which gets compensated with maids salary in area like metro i.e. mumbai , pune etc.. Go for it...

user_reviews.title: Worth the money
user_reviews.review_text: Nice product...works good but it's always better if u buy 14 plate setting..I found it little small for 4 people family..but works well .. U have to remove leftover food particles U must have water tap near the machine..it's always better to keep machine in kitchen it's more convenient ...overall good built quality , demo also given very well I think monthly cost will be around 1500 including salt ,rinse aid detergent and electricity

user_reviews.title: We got rid of the maid right away *****
user_reviews.review_text: It has been nearly six months down the line and I wanted to wait before writing a review. 1. Delivery was fast and installation took some time but only because our kitchen site was not ready. So full marks there. 2. The Bosch Dishwasher is one of the best in India right now. It has all the settings and the frills - and I won't go into the tech specs. 3. The product does it job very well. Our blackened iron kadhai and other such iron utensils started getting back the sheen slowly. The SS utensils are clean. The dishes sparkle. We do gently pre-rinse the utensils to get rid of large food particles. 4. We use the standard 1' 10" cycle. Our use is every second evening (we are just three people). 5 We live in Pune centre of town and water is fairly light - salt is not strictly needed but we put it anyway. 6. We are using "Finish" brand detergent and rinse-aid. I suggest that prospective buyers do the same. 7. The washing is fairly quiet and in our adjacent living room sofa, we are just about aware that the d/w is running. Highly recommended. We are not using the maid anymore. We are getting better results and there is complete freedom. A note: The dishwasher is actually silver in colour. There is a golden thin film on the front cover which can be peeled off. Have no idea why a golden colour protective film was used; a transparent would have been a better option.
